routes.label: at an office of the Directorate of Nationality, Passports and Immigration

note: The fee is unsettled in what could be read: Radio Tamazuj (12 November 2024) reported SSP 30,000 for a nationality card, the legislature having rejected a proposed rise; the Directorate's acting director in Yei told Access Radio (10 July 2026) that the processing fee for a national identity card is 'over 50,000' pounds under government regulations. No exact current figure was found, so the fee is null, as are the card's term, the age and the time.

sources.title: Radio Tamazuj, MPs reject proposed increment of passport, ID fees (12 November 2024)
sources.said: South Sudan currently charges SSP 30,000 for a nationality card, and USD 100 for a regular (ordinary) passport

sources.title: Access Radio (Radio Yei), Yei residents begin collecting nationality cards (10 July 2026)
sources.said: According to Akuai, a South Sudan passport currently costs US$100, while the processing fee for a national identity card is over 50,000 South Sudanese Pounds (SSP), in line with government regulations.
